sloka: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः ।अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्ष्यामवारुहत् ।। ७.८२.१८ ॥
transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte pūjyamānastatastataḥ ।ayodhyāṁ prāpya kākutstho madhyakakṣyāmavāruhat ।। 7.82.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, by midday, Rama, being honored from all sides, reached Ayodhya and descended into the middle chamber of his palace.
